global_guardrails: Parallelize only work units with explicit independence or an explicit dependency graph.
Keep concurrent writes to one file, Git index, database, device, external account, or release manifest serial unless the underlying tool provides safe isolation and locking.
Give every parallel worker an isolated output, cache, and temporary directory, then merge deterministically in one coordinator step.
Keep deterministic seeds, environment locks, resource limits, and preregistered execution order intact for reproducible scientific work.
Treat network, approval, queue, and user-interaction delay separately from compute time; never report them as parallel compute savings.
Use live_runner for executions expected to exceed ten seconds so progress and estimated savings remain visible in real time.
For safety-critical hardware, production release, medical, automotive, mains, battery, RF, or high-voltage work, require the project-specific checks and human engineering sign-off.

scenarios.title_zh: 科研实验矩阵与参数扫描

default_execution.isolation: one result/receipt and temporary directory per case

optimization_goals.objective: Parallelize independent dataset, seed, parameter, rank, fold, or method cases.
optimization_goals.metric: experiment makespan and completed cases per minute

optimization_goals.objective: Write one immutable receipt per case and merge in a stable key order.
optimization_goals.metric: zero output collisions and byte-stable merged manifests

optimization_goals.objective: Resume only missing or failed cases without rerunning successful work.

guardrails: Do not split a preregistered sequential phase unless its protocol explicitly permits it.
Set BLAS/OpenMP threads per worker to prevent oversubscription when using process-level parallelism.

scenarios.title_zh: Bootstrap、交叉验证与统计重采样

default_execution.isolation: deterministic child seed and one shard per resample range

optimization_goals.objective: Use deterministic SeedSequence-style child streams for independent repetitions.
Aggregate sufficient statistics instead of retaining all samples in every worker.
Merge shards in a fixed order with numerically stable reductions.

guardrails: Do not reuse random streams across workers.
Keep sequential stopping rules and adaptive sampling decisions in the coordinator.

scenarios.title_zh: 论文、补充材料与投稿包构建

default_execution.isolation: separate latex output directory per root document

optimization_goals.objective: Build independent main papers, supplements, appendices, and cover letters concurrently.
Render independent PDFs or page ranges concurrently for visual QA.
Run citation, claim, package, and artifact-integrity checks after all builds finish.

guardrails: Keep one document's LaTeX/BibTeX rerun chain serial.
Never let two workers share the same auxiliary or output directory.

scenarios.title_zh: 数值线性代数与高维计算

default_execution.isolation: choose either threaded kernel or process fan-out, not both at full width

optimization_goals.objective: Prefer Accelerate-backed BLAS/LAPACK or an explicitly implemented Metal/MPS backend.
Coordinate process count with BLAS/OpenMP thread count.
Block matrices and cap workers using per-task unified-memory estimates.

guardrails: Do not claim GPU or Accelerate use unless the invoked implementation exposes and confirms it.
Preserve numerical tolerances and deterministic comparison baselines.

scenarios.title_zh: 单元测试、集成测试与兼容性矩阵

default_execution.isolation: one temporary/cache/output root per test shard

optimization_goals.objective: Shard independent test modules or platform/configuration cells.
optimization_goals.metric: test wall time and shard balance

optimization_goals.objective: Balance shards using historical per-module duration rather than test count alone.
Rerun only failed idempotent shards with full diagnostics.

guardrails: Keep tests that share ports, devices, fixed databases, simulators, or mutable fixtures serial unless isolated.
Run one final aggregate or release gate after sharded tests.

scenarios.title_zh: 多应用全栈质量门与集成构建

default_execution.isolation: one cache/output root per application; explicit service-contract and final integration stages

optimization_goals.objective: Run read-only lint, typecheck, frontend tests, backend tests, and package checks concurrently when their outputs are isolated.
Build shared contracts first, then fan out dependent frontend and backend checks.
optimization_goals.metric: critical-path duration and avoided duplicate contract builds

optimization_goals.objective: Run one dependency-ordered production build and cross-service acceptance gate after branch checks pass.

guardrails: Do not run two framework builds against the same cache or output directory.
Keep database migration, fixed ports, shared services, and final deployment dependency-ordered.

scenarios.title_zh: C/C++/Rust/Go 编译图

default_execution.isolation: use the build system dependency graph and separate build directories per configuration

optimization_goals.objective: Use the build system's native job server for independent compilation units.
Build independent architectures, sanitizers, and configurations in isolated directories.
Reuse safe compiler caches while avoiding concurrent cache corruption.

guardrails: Keep final linking and shared generated-file steps dependency-ordered.
Do not stack plugin fan-out on top of an already saturated native build job server.

scenarios.title_zh: Monorepo 多包依赖图

default_execution.isolation: respect package dependencies and per-package outputs

optimization_goals.objective: Run work only for changed packages and their dependents.
Execute dependency-ready packages concurrently.
Reuse content-addressed package build outputs.

guardrails: Keep lockfile writes and workspace installation serial.
Do not run dependents before required generated artifacts are complete.

scenarios.title_zh: AI 辅助生成工程的稳定化与收敛验证

default_execution.isolation: parallel read-only audits and isolated test branches; one coordinated mutation and convergence path

optimization_goals.objective: Classify generated surfaces by authority, statefulness, public contract, and change frequency before spending build time.
optimization_goals.metric: high-risk surfaces covered and irrelevant work skipped

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent contract, permission, schema, UX, dead-code, and test-coverage audits concurrently with normalized evidence.
Apply fixes in dependency order and finish with affected checks plus one full authoritative quality gate.
optimization_goals.metric: iterations to green and regression escape rate

guardrails: Do not let multiple workers edit overlapping source files or silently choose conflicting product behavior.
Read-only audit parallelism must converge into one deduplicated risk-ranked plan before mutation.

scenarios.title_zh: 实时协作、WebSocket 与多服务联调

default_execution.isolation: unique ports, rooms, users, databases, and trace directories per test cell

optimization_goals.objective: Start database and backing services first, then application and collaboration services, with health-gated readiness.
optimization_goals.metric: time to ready and eliminated blind sleeps

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent authorization, reconnect, conflict, awareness, persistence, and cross-service contract tests concurrently.
Fan out room or document load cases only with isolated identities and bounded socket counts.
optimization_goals.metric: operations per second, convergence latency, and error rate

guardrails: Do not share fixed ports, room identifiers, users, mutable documents, or one database fixture across parallel cells.
Keep migrations, destructive resets, and final convergence assertions dependency-ordered.

scenarios.title_zh: AI Agent、MCP 与权限治理审计

default_execution.isolation: parallel read-only boundary and contract audits; one serial policy-decision and mutation stage

optimization_goals.objective: Audit authentication, authorization, delegation, origin, retention, rate-limit, and evidence boundaries concurrently.
Run independent native, MCP, HTTP, CLI, and persistence contract tests using isolated identities and stores.
Deduplicate findings and make authority-changing policy decisions in one explicit serial gate.
optimization_goals.metric: zero contradictory policies and complete decision evidence

guardrails: Never parallelize writes to one policy store, token registry, audit log, or external account.
Optimization does not grant permission to invoke agents or mutate external systems beyond the requested scope.

scenarios.title_zh: 静态分析、类型检查与安全扫描

default_execution.isolation: independent read-only scanners with separate reports

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent linters, type checkers, secret scanners, SBOM, and static security checks concurrently.
Partition scanners by language or immutable source subtree.
Normalize and deduplicate findings in one serial report step.

guardrails: Do not execute untrusted project code as part of a static scan.
Keep auto-fix mode serial because it mutates shared files.

scenarios.title_zh: 大型代码库只读检索与盘点

default_execution.isolation: coarse read-only search batches

optimization_goals.objective: Combine many tiny rg/sed/find calls into a few independent searches.
optimization_goals.metric: tool round trips and discovery latency

optimization_goals.objective: Search independent large subtrees concurrently when each scan is substantial.
Reuse one file inventory or symbol index across follow-up questions.

guardrails: Do not parallelize tiny commands when process startup dominates.
Exclude generated, dependency, cache, and VCS directories unless explicitly needed.

scenarios.title_zh: 浏览器端到端测试矩阵

default_execution.isolation: unique browser profile, port, account, artifact directory, and test data per shard

optimization_goals.objective: Shard independent specs across isolated browser workers.
Run independent browser/device projects concurrently within service capacity.
Stream failures while keeping trace, video, and screenshot outputs per worker.

guardrails: Cap workers when they share a local server or authenticated external account.
Keep database reset and environment provisioning dependency-ordered.

scenarios.title_zh: 分区数据 ETL 与格式转换

default_execution.isolation: one immutable output partition per input partition

optimization_goals.objective: Transform independent files, partitions, dates, or entities concurrently.
optimization_goals.metric: rows or bytes processed per second

optimization_goals.objective: Read only required columns and row groups before parallel work.
Validate all partitions before one atomic manifest publication.

guardrails: Do not let workers append to one CSV or JSONL file.
Keep schema evolution and destination table commits serial unless transactional partitioning is proven.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据质量与证据一致性验证

default_execution.isolation: read-only validation partitions and independent evidence reports

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent schema, range, uniqueness, referential, and drift checks concurrently.
Validate immutable partitions in parallel and reduce counts centrally.
Surface blocking integrity failures immediately while other independent checks continue safely.

guardrails: Keep repair or imputation writes out of the parallel validation stage.
Use one authoritative aggregation step for final pass/fail status.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据库迁移与共享状态工作流

default_execution.isolation: parallelize read-only preparation only; serialize mutation and commit

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent backups, schema checks, row counts, and dry-run analyses before mutation.
Parallelize backfill only when the database and key ranges provide proven isolation and transactions.
optimization_goals.metric: rows updated per second without lock contention

optimization_goals.objective: Keep migration ordering, metadata updates, and final commit serial.

guardrails: Default shared database writes to concurrency one.
Require explicit locking, transactions, idempotency, and recovery plan before partitioned writes.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据库种子、Fixture 与验收数据矩阵

default_execution.isolation: one disposable database/schema and one receipt per seed profile

optimization_goals.objective: Validate independent seed profiles, fixture syntax, references, and deterministic identifiers concurrently without writes.
Run seed and acceptance profiles concurrently only against separate disposable databases or schemas.
optimization_goals.metric: profiles validated per minute without cross-contamination

optimization_goals.objective: Keep the selected shared-environment seed, migration metadata, and publication path serial and receipted.
optimization_goals.metric: zero duplicate or conflicting shared records

guardrails: Never run multiple seed writers against one shared database unless the scripts are explicitly transactional and idempotent.
Use deterministic identifiers, cleanup receipts, and disposable test databases for parallel cells.

scenarios.title_zh: 批量图片处理与视觉资产导出

default_execution.isolation: one output path per source image

optimization_goals.objective: Transform independent images concurrently.
Prefer vImage/Accelerate or an explicitly supported GPU backend for resize, color, and convolution operators.
Combine multiple requested transforms per image to avoid repeated decode and encode.
optimization_goals.metric: decode count and total bytes processed

guardrails: Keep metadata policy and overwrite behavior explicit.
Use low accelerator fan-out when each worker drives the same GPU or unified-memory-heavy model.

scenarios.title_zh: 视频转码、切片与代理文件生成

default_execution.isolation: one output family per source with shared media-engine-aware cap

optimization_goals.objective: Use an explicitly selected VideoToolbox encoder/decoder when quality and codec requirements permit.
optimization_goals.metric: realtime factor and hardware encoder confirmation

optimization_goals.objective: Process independent source videos with a low shared-media-engine concurrency cap.
Generate multiple renditions from one decode/filter graph when supported.

guardrails: More concurrent hardware encoders may reduce total throughput; measure at caps one and two first.
Preserve color, HDR, audio, subtitle, and timing metadata requirements.

scenarios.title_zh: 音频、语音与信号批处理

default_execution.isolation: one result per source or independent time chunk with deterministic overlap handling

optimization_goals.objective: Process independent audio files concurrently.
Use vDSP/Accelerate for FFT, filtering, convolution, and vector transforms when implemented.
optimization_goals.metric: signal samples per second and backend confirmation

optimization_goals.objective: Chunk long signals with explicit overlap and one serial boundary merge.

guardrails: Do not chunk stateful codecs or filters without preserving state and overlap semantics.
Cap shared speech-model/GPU workers to unified-memory capacity.

scenarios.title_zh: PDF 渲染、抽取与视觉验收

default_execution.isolation: unique render prefix per PDF/page range

optimization_goals.objective: Render independent PDFs or page ranges concurrently.
Run independent text/metadata extraction alongside visual rendering.
After edits, rerender changed or representative pages before the final complete pass.

guardrails: Final delivery still requires complete relevant-page verification.
Use separate output prefixes to prevent Poppler output collisions.

scenarios.title_zh: OCR 与文档格式批量转换

default_execution.isolation: one output package per source document

optimization_goals.objective: Convert independent documents concurrently.
OCR independent pages in bounded shards and reassemble in page order.
Skip OCR on pages with trustworthy embedded text.

guardrails: Preserve document order, accessibility structure, and source fidelity in one final assembly step.
Do not overwrite source documents by default.

scenarios.title_zh: 机器学习批量推理

default_execution.isolation: batch within one model process before adding competing accelerator processes

optimization_goals.objective: Prefer Core ML all compute units when the model is compatible and conversion is validated.
Increase in-process batch size before process fan-out.
optimization_goals.metric: items per second within memory limit

optimization_goals.objective: Load each model once and stream many items through it.
optimization_goals.metric: model load count and warm throughput

guardrails: Multiple GPU/ANE processes can reduce throughput; default to one or two.
Validate numerical and task-quality equivalence after model conversion.

scenarios.title_zh: 机器学习超参数与训练试验

default_execution.isolation: one run directory, seed, checkpoint namespace, and metrics receipt per trial

optimization_goals.objective: Schedule independent trials within unified-memory and accelerator limits.
Stop underperforming trials using coordinator-owned evidence.
Reuse immutable preprocessed data without duplicating it per trial.

guardrails: Start at concurrency one for shared GPU/ANE training and increase only from measured throughput.
Keep checkpoints and experiment trackers isolated by trial.

scenarios.title_zh: 模型转换、量化与后端基准

default_execution.isolation: separate converted artifact and benchmark output per backend/precision

optimization_goals.objective: Convert independent precision and backend variants concurrently.
Run correctness comparisons before performance benchmarking.
Benchmark accepted variants with warmup and controlled serial baselines.

guardrails: Do not compare performance for variants that fail quality equivalence.
Avoid benchmarking multiple shared-accelerator variants concurrently.

scenarios.title_zh: 容器、多架构构建与隔离实验

default_execution.isolation: unique image tag, build directory, container name, and output per architecture/case

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent resource-bounded containers concurrently.
Build independent architectures or images concurrently when cache and builder capacity permit.
Order Dockerfiles and contexts to maximize immutable layer reuse.
optimization_goals.metric: cache hit rate and transferred bytes

guardrails: Cap emulated x86 containers on Apple silicon after measuring contention.
Keep shared tags, manifests, registry publication, and cleanup serial.

scenarios.title_zh: Docker Desktop 虚拟机总资源边界

default_execution.isolation: measure and reserve the Docker Linux VM envelope before distributing resources to containers

optimization_goals.objective: Base container budgets on Docker Desktop VM CPUs and memory, not directly on the larger macOS host totals.
optimization_goals.metric: allocated container resources / Docker VM envelope

optimization_goals.objective: Reserve VM memory and CPU for dockerd, BuildKit, networking, filesystem sharing, and interactive host responsiveness.
optimization_goals.metric: VM swap, OOM events, and host responsiveness

optimization_goals.objective: Use container stats and measured throttling to revise limits after a representative run.
optimization_goals.metric: CPU throttling, memory peak, I/O, and wall time

guardrails: Changing Docker Desktop's VM-wide settings is an explicit user action and may restart the engine.
Host RAM and cores unavailable to the Docker VM cannot be assigned to containers.

scenarios.title_zh: 多容器 CPU、内存、PID 与 vCPU 分区

default_execution.isolation: weighted quotas inside one detected Docker VM envelope; optional non-overlapping VM-vCPU cpusets

optimization_goals.objective: Assign CPU-heavy builds larger CPU ceilings and contention weights while keeping I/O services smaller.
Set memory limit/reservation and PID ceilings from measured working sets and runtime behavior.
optimization_goals.metric: zero OOMs, fork storms, and VM swap

optimization_goals.objective: Use cpuset only when non-overlap is beneficial and enough Docker VM vCPUs exist.

guardrails: Docker Desktop cpuset IDs are VM vCPUs, not stable Apple P-core/E-core identities.
CPU quotas are ceilings and cpu_shares are relative weights under contention, not guaranteed reservations.

scenarios.title_zh: Compose 服务依赖、健康检查与就绪 DAG

default_execution.isolation: dependency-ready service groups with health-gated transitions and unique project/network names

optimization_goals.objective: Replace fixed sleeps with service health and completion conditions.
optimization_goals.metric: startup latency and flaky readiness failures

optimization_goals.objective: Start independent services together as soon as their dependencies are healthy.
Model migrations, initialization, and asset generation as one-shot dependency nodes.
optimization_goals.metric: zero application starts before required state exists

guardrails: A running process is not necessarily a ready service.
Keep migrations and other shared-state initialization single-writer and dependency-ordered.

scenarios.title_zh: BuildKit 求解器并发、缓存与构建容器预算

default_execution.isolation: bounded BuildKit solver parallelism, immutable cache inputs, unique tags, and one manifest publication path

optimization_goals.objective: Set BuildKit worker max-parallelism from Docker VM CPU and memory headroom.
optimization_goals.metric: build wall time, VM memory peak, and throttling

optimization_goals.objective: Expose independent multi-stage build branches while keeping dependent and final image stages ordered.
Use safe cache mounts and remote/local cache imports without concurrent cache corruption.
optimization_goals.metric: layer and package cache hit rate

guardrails: Do not stack many outer docker build processes on top of an already saturated BuildKit solver.
Keep shared image tags, multi-arch manifests, signing, and pushes serial.

scenarios.title_zh: 容器化测试矩阵与环境隔离

default_execution.isolation: unique Compose project, network, ports, database schema/volume, container names, and output artifacts per matrix cell

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent runtime, dependency, schema, or configuration cells concurrently within VM resource limits.
Assign unique Compose project names, networks, ports, volumes, and fixture identities.
Retain logs and retry only failed idempotent cells without rebuilding successful cells.

guardrails: Do not reuse one mutable database or named volume across concurrent test cells.
Apply per-cell resource limits so one failure cannot starve the entire Docker VM.

scenarios.title_zh: Bind Mount、Named Volume 与宿主机文件 I/O

content_patterns.label: container bind mount or named volume

default_execution.isolation: source bind mounts only where interactive editing is needed; named volumes for high-churn Linux data; minimal build context

optimization_goals.objective: Use named volumes for databases, package caches, and high-churn Linux data while retaining source bind mounts where needed.
Exclude dependencies, VCS, outputs, archives, and caches from build contexts.
Measure representative bind-mount and synchronized-share workflows before changing storage topology.

guardrails: Changing volumes can alter persistence and backup semantics.
Do not move authoritative user data without an explicit migration and recovery plan.

scenarios.title_zh: Apple Silicon 容器架构与仿真成本

default_execution.isolation: native arm64 path first; separately tagged and resource-capped emulated compatibility cells

optimization_goals.objective: Prefer native linux/arm64 images and toolchains on Apple silicon whenever compatibility permits.
Use BuildKit build/target platform separation and cross-compilation instead of executing every build step under emulation.
Run amd64 compatibility cells with low measured concurrency and isolated caches.

guardrails: Never silently substitute architectures when binary compatibility is part of the test.
Emulated containers may need different timing thresholds and lower fan-out.

scenarios.title_zh: 共享数据库、缓存、搜索与对象存储容器竞争

default_execution.isolation: one authoritative shared service with bounded clients, or one disposable isolated service per independent test cell

optimization_goals.objective: Reserve explicit CPU, memory, PID, file-descriptor, and storage headroom for stateful services.
optimization_goals.metric: query latency, OOMs, compaction, and queue depth

optimization_goals.objective: Bound aggregate application workers and connection pools below shared-service capacity.
optimization_goals.metric: active connections, lock waits, and rejected requests

optimization_goals.objective: Use disposable databases, schemas, topics, buckets, or indexes for truly parallel mutation tests.

guardrails: Shared stateful services remain the bottleneck even when client containers have separate CPUs.
Do not run destructive or migration tests concurrently against one authoritative data volume.

scenarios.title_zh: 镜像层、Registry 传输与清单发布

default_execution.isolation: immutable content-addressed layers and tags per job; one final manifest/signing/publication coordinator

optimization_goals.objective: Order stable dependencies before frequently changing sources and share immutable base layers across images.
Respect BuildKit and registry connection limits rather than multiplying outer pull/push processes.
Build and verify architecture-specific images independently, then publish one manifest and tag set serially.

guardrails: Parallelism does not authorize registry pushes or overwriting shared tags.
Keep signing credentials and final release publication on one explicit path.

scenarios.title_zh: 归档、哈希与发布包生成

default_execution.isolation: one immutable artifact per task followed by serial manifest assembly

optimization_goals.objective: Build independent archives and artifact variants concurrently.
Hash independent immutable artifacts concurrently.
Create and sign one final manifest after all artifacts are stable.

guardrails: Do not hash or package files that are still being written.
Keep signing keys and publication steps serial and within the user's authorization.

scenarios.title_zh: Xcode、Swift 与 Apple 平台构建测试

default_execution.isolation: separate DerivedData, result bundle, simulator/device, and destination per build/test shard

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent schemes, destinations, and test plans concurrently when isolated.
Build once for testing, then fan out compatible test destinations.
Use explicit per-job DerivedData and result bundle paths.

guardrails: Do not share one simulator, DerivedData directory, or signing destination across workers.
Keep archive, notarization, signing, and upload steps serial.

scenarios.title_zh: 网站多页面构建与静态资源处理

default_execution.isolation: framework-native page graph and immutable asset outputs

optimization_goals.objective: Generate independent routes or locale variants concurrently through the framework's native scheduler.
Process independent images, fonts, and bundles concurrently.
Rebuild only affected pages and assets.

guardrails: Prefer framework-native concurrency over nested process fan-out.
Keep deployment and shared cache publication serial unless provider semantics guarantee safety.

scenarios.title_zh: 三维渲染、动画帧与仿真帧

default_execution.isolation: one frame range and output directory per worker

optimization_goals.objective: Render independent frames or shots concurrently.
Use historical frame cost to balance nonuniform shots.
Resume only missing or invalid frames before final encoding.

guardrails: GPU render processes compete for one GPU and unified memory; start with one or two.
Encode the final sequence only after frame completeness and consistency checks.

scenarios.title_zh: EDA、PCB 与硬件设计验证

default_execution.isolation: read-only or separately emitted verification artifacts

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent ERC, DRC, BOM, footprint, Gerber, and static rule checks concurrently when source tools support read-only operation.
Generate independent preview, drill, assembly, and documentation artifacts into isolated outputs.
Aggregate all automated evidence before a serial fabrication-readiness decision.

guardrails: Do not concurrently mutate one schematic or board database.
Automated checks do not replace human engineering sign-off, especially for safety-critical or production hardware.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据下载、镜像拉取与同步

default_execution.isolation: one verified temporary destination per object

optimization_goals.objective: Download independent objects with a low host- and bandwidth-aware cap.
Resume partial transfers and reuse checksum-verified local cache entries.
Verify size, checksum, provenance, and archive structure before moving into final location.

guardrails: Authorization, approval, rate-limit, and queue delay are not compute savings.
Do not overload one host or hide transfer failures behind high concurrency.

scenarios.title_zh: 后台 Worker、Cron 与 Outbox 可靠性验证

default_execution.isolation: one disposable queue/database namespace and clock/control channel per worker scenario

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent worker types, retry policies, retention windows, and batch-size cases concurrently in isolated environments.
Exercise timeout, duplicate delivery, lease expiry, fencing, crash recovery, and idempotency cases with deterministic clocks and receipts.
Finish with one bounded shared-queue integration test to verify ordering, contention, and exactly-once-or-idempotent effects.
optimization_goals.metric: zero duplicate effects and complete retry evidence

guardrails: Do not parallelize workers against one production or shared development queue/database.
Use explicit time budgets, stable idempotency keys, isolated ports, and cleanup receipts.

scenarios.title_zh: 远程 API、连接器与云端批量调用

default_execution.isolation: provider-native batch requests and rate-limit-aware independent calls

optimization_goals.objective: Use the owning provider's batch or Codex native concurrent tool calls instead of proxying through local subprocesses.
Bound concurrency using provider quotas and backoff headers.
Retry only idempotent failed calls with stable request identifiers.
optimization_goals.metric: recovered calls without duplicate side effects

guardrails: This MCP server cannot internally accelerate another provider's API.
Keep external mutations serial unless their targets and idempotency are independent and authorized.

scenarios.title_zh: 嵌套线程池与原生计算过度订阅

default_execution.isolation: one concurrency hierarchy: either process fan-out or native kernel threads receive the core budget

optimization_goals.objective: Choose one top-level parallel hierarchy instead of multiplying process, runtime, BLAS, and OpenMP widths.
optimization_goals.metric: runnable threads / active cores and CPU efficiency

optimization_goals.objective: Derive native thread limits from the chosen worker count and current active cores.
optimization_goals.metric: throughput without context-switch or thermal regression

optimization_goals.objective: Benchmark small safe caps and retain the fastest thermally stable configuration.
optimization_goals.metric: wall time at caps 1, 2, 4, and adaptive default

guardrails: Do not set every process and every native library to all cores.
Preserve deterministic numerical tolerances while changing execution width.

scenarios.title_zh: Python GIL、线程池与进程池选择

default_execution.isolation: bounded non-executing source analysis first; threads for reviewed blocking I/O, processes for reviewed coarse pure-Python CPU units, native owners for vector kernels

optimization_goals.objective: Use threads for I/O and GIL-releasing native kernels, processes for coarse pure-Python CPU work, and vectorization before either.
optimization_goals.metric: useful CPU time and wall time

optimization_goals.objective: Batch items so serialization and process startup remain a small fraction of task time.
Pass compact immutable references or shared read-only data instead of copying large Python objects.
optimization_goals.metric: IPC bytes and worker peak memory

optimization_goals.objective: Use bounded AST/effect analysis, source-hash-bound rewrite previews, semantic differential tests, and measured break-even evidence before accepting a source refactor.
optimization_goals.metric: correctness certificate and measured p50/p90 speedup

guardrails: Do not use a process pool for tiny functions or unpicklable state.
Use spawn-safe entry points and deterministic child seeds.
A long runtime is only a trigger for analysis; unknown effects, shared writes, order-sensitive behavior, or stale source hashes keep the program serial.

scenarios.title_zh: Node.js 事件循环、Worker Threads 与进程池

default_execution.isolation: native async concurrency for I/O; reusable worker pool and transferable buffers for substantial CPU work

optimization_goals.objective: Keep network and filesystem concurrency on native async APIs; move only CPU-heavy operators to worker threads.
Reuse a bounded worker pool instead of creating one worker or child process per tiny item.
Transfer or share ArrayBuffers where ownership semantics permit instead of cloning payloads.

guardrails: Promise concurrency does not accelerate CPU-bound JavaScript on one event loop.
Do not share mutable non-atomic state across worker threads.

scenarios.title_zh: SIMD、Accelerate 与向量化内核

default_execution.isolation: fused contiguous vector kernels with coordinated library thread limits

optimization_goals.objective: Replace scalar interpreter or element loops with fused array, vDSP, vImage, BNNS, or BLAS operations.
Use contiguous aligned layouts and stride-aware kernels to reduce gather, conversion, and cache misses.
Confirm the invoked implementation actually selects Accelerate or another vectorized backend.

guardrails: Vectorization changes floating-point reduction order; preserve required tolerances.
Avoid process fan-out that competes with an already threaded vector kernel.

scenarios.title_zh: Metal、MPSGraph 与统一内存算子

default_execution.isolation: one shared accelerator budget; batch operators and reuse command queues, compiled graphs, and buffers

optimization_goals.objective: Offload only sufficiently large data-parallel kernels whose implementation exposes Metal, MPSGraph, MLX, or MPS.
Batch and fuse compatible kernels to amortize command submission and intermediate materialization.
optimization_goals.metric: command buffers and temporary bytes per item

optimization_goals.objective: Reuse buffers and keep working sets within available unified-memory headroom.

guardrails: Do not claim GPU acceleration from hardware availability alone.
Multiple GPU-driving processes often contend; start at concurrency one or two.

scenarios.title_zh: 内存复制、临时对象与缓冲区复用

default_execution.isolation: bounded reusable buffers with explicit ownership and per-worker memory estimates

optimization_goals.objective: Identify unavoidable versus accidental full-buffer copies across parsing, IPC, transforms, and output.
Reuse bounded buffers and temporaries across items when ownership is explicit.
Use views, memory maps, transferable buffers, or shared read-only pages where correctness permits.

guardrails: Zero-copy designs require explicit lifetime and ownership rules.
Reduce concurrency when aggregate working sets approach unified-memory headroom.

scenarios.title_zh: 流式、分块与背压 I/O

default_execution.isolation: bounded producer-transform-consumer queues and one immutable output per stream

optimization_goals.objective: Process large inputs incrementally instead of loading every input and intermediate into memory.
optimization_goals.metric: peak memory and time to first output

optimization_goals.objective: Overlap read, transform, and write stages with bounded queues and backpressure.
Choose chunks large enough to amortize syscalls but small enough for cache and memory headroom.

guardrails: Do not let unbounded queues convert an I/O optimization into a memory spike.
Preserve record, Unicode, compression-frame, and transaction boundaries when chunking.

scenarios.title_zh: 目录遍历、元数据查询与源码索引

default_execution.isolation: one reusable inventory; coarse independent subtrees; generated and dependency trees excluded

optimization_goals.objective: Build one bounded file inventory and reuse it across searches, counts, and classifiers.
Scan only substantial independent subtrees concurrently instead of spawning per-file commands.
Reuse ripgrep, language-server, build-system, or content indexes for repeated questions.

guardrails: Exclude VCS, dependency, generated, cache, and output trees by default.
Do not parallelize tiny directory walks that compete for one disk metadata queue.

scenarios.title_zh: 海量小文件的批量读取与聚合

default_execution.isolation: coarse file batches with one result shard per batch and deterministic merge

optimization_goals.objective: Group many tiny files into coarse read/parse work units to amortize process, open, and metadata overhead.
Persist a compact manifest of path, size, mtime, and content hash for incremental reuse.
Emit batch-local results and merge once in path order.

guardrails: More workers do not help when one storage metadata queue is saturated.
Do not archive source trees merely for speed when random access or incremental builds require individual files.

scenarios.title_zh: 增量构建、内容寻址缓存与受影响范围

default_execution.isolation: content-addressed cache keys, per-job temporary caches, and one serial cache publication step

optimization_goals.objective: Use dependency and content fingerprints to run only affected packages, routes, tests, or artifacts.
Include source, toolchain, flags, environment, and dependency inputs in cache keys.
Let workers read safe caches but publish or compact shared cache state through one coordinator.

guardrails: Never trade correctness for a high hit rate; stale outputs must fail validation.
Avoid concurrent writers to cache formats without documented locking.

scenarios.title_zh: JSON、CSV、XML 与结构化解析热点

default_execution.isolation: one immutable input partition and typed output shard per parser worker

optimization_goals.objective: Use a measured native or SIMD parser when semantics and deployment constraints match.
Parse and validate once, then pass typed or columnar representations through downstream stages.
Parallelize independent files or boundary-safe record partitions and reduce centrally.

guardrails: Preserve number precision, Unicode, duplicate-key, date, and schema semantics when changing parsers.
Do not split compressed or quoted record streams at arbitrary byte offsets.

scenarios.title_zh: 压缩、解压、校验和与内容寻址流水线

default_execution.isolation: one archive member, independent object, or hash shard per worker; one deterministic manifest coordinator

optimization_goals.objective: Stream compression and hashing in one pass where output and verification semantics permit.
Use Apple Compression, hardware-supported codecs, or measured native libraries exposed by the implementation.
Hash independent immutable objects concurrently and build the final manifest or tree hash serially.

guardrails: Do not parallelize writes into one archive unless the archive library explicitly supports deterministic safe assembly.
Verification must cover final bytes, not only worker-local intermediates.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据库只读查询扇出与连接池

default_execution.isolation: read-only snapshot-consistent queries bounded below the database connection-pool and server capacity

optimization_goals.objective: Run truly independent read queries concurrently within a measured connection budget.
optimization_goals.metric: request latency and database active sessions

optimization_goals.objective: Prefer joins, batched keys, prefetch, or data loaders before multiplying round trips.
Use an explicit consistency model when parallel reads must describe one logical point in time.

guardrails: Do not exceed the connection pool or shift the bottleneck into database lock, CPU, or disk pressure.
Parallel reads are unsafe when later queries depend on earlier results or must share one transaction snapshot.

scenarios.title_zh: 数据库批量写入、事务与分区提交

default_execution.isolation: batch within transactions; parallelize only disjoint key ranges or disposable database partitions with one commit coordinator

optimization_goals.objective: Replace per-row round trips with bounded bulk APIs, prepared statements, or database-native loading.
optimization_goals.metric: round trips and rows written per second

optimization_goals.objective: Choose transaction batches that balance log pressure, locks, rollback cost, and throughput.
Parallelize writes only after proving disjoint keys, idempotency, locking, and recovery.
optimization_goals.metric: zero conflicts, duplicates, and partial publication

guardrails: Default shared database mutation concurrency to one.
Migrations, metadata, sequences, uniqueness constraints, and final publication remain dependency-ordered.

scenarios.title_zh: HTTP 连接复用、多路复用与限流

default_execution.isolation: one reusable client per authority with host-, quota-, and idempotency-aware bounds

optimization_goals.objective: Reuse TLS connections and client pools instead of constructing a client per request.
Use provider-supported HTTP/2 or native batch endpoints when semantics match.
optimization_goals.metric: remote round trips and concurrent streams

optimization_goals.objective: Adjust concurrency from rate-limit, latency, error, and retry feedback.

guardrails: Remote concurrency remains subject to provider authorization, quotas, and side-effect semantics.
Retry only idempotent calls or calls carrying stable idempotency keys.

scenarios.title_zh: 高频小命令与进程启动摊销

default_execution.isolation: coarse batched commands or persistent workers; no per-file subprocess fan-out

optimization_goals.objective: Combine related rg, jq, compiler, parser, or transform operations into coarse invocations.
optimization_goals.metric: process launches and tool round trips

optimization_goals.objective: Reuse a daemon, language server, REPL, build server, or worker pool when repeated startup dominates.
Keep parallel units above measured startup thresholds and batch smaller items.

guardrails: Do not hide unrelated failures inside an opaque mega-command.
Preserve per-item result attribution and retry boundaries when batching.

scenarios.title_zh: GPU、ANE 与媒体引擎共享资源竞争

default_execution.isolation: one shared accelerator budget with measured caps, bounded unified memory, and no nested GPU process fan-out

optimization_goals.objective: Measure total throughput at accelerator concurrency one and two before increasing.
optimization_goals.metric: items per second and p95 latency by cap

optimization_goals.objective: Account for model, graph, texture, frame, and temporary-buffer unified memory per worker.
Increase batch size or fuse work inside one accelerator process before adding competing processes.
optimization_goals.metric: accelerator utilization and dispatches per item

guardrails: More accelerator processes often reduce throughput and foreground responsiveness.
Backend presence must be verified by the invoked implementation, not inferred from the Mac model.

scenarios.title_zh: Git、版本发布与共享清单

default_execution.isolation: parallelize read-only preflight; serialize index, version, tag, signing, and publication mutations

optimization_goals.objective: Run independent tests, builds, diffs, changelog checks, and artifact validation concurrently before release mutation.
Use one coordinator for version files, lockfiles, manifests, Git index, commits, tags, and signatures.
Verify final local refs and artifacts before any authorized publication.

guardrails: Never concurrently mutate one Git index or release manifest.
Parallelism does not authorize push, publication, signing, or remote release actions.

scenarios.title_zh: 共享文件、设备与外部账户写入

default_execution.isolation: prepare independent immutable inputs in parallel, then perform one authorized mutation path

optimization_goals.objective: Prepare and validate independent immutable inputs concurrently before touching shared state.
Use one writer or transaction coordinator for the shared resource.
Capture backup, rollback, receipt, and post-write verification evidence.

guardrails: Default concurrency is one for shared mutable resources.
Do not infer authorization for external or destructive side effects from a request to optimize timing.
